'''Sabacc Sav''' was a [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] aboard [[Carrick Station]] during the conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He shared his name with the game [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]].<ref name="TOR" />

Sabacc Sav had [[Color/Legends|orange]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and skin that was colored orange and green. He wore a white [[Greatcoat/Legends|greatcoat]] with black and brown highlights, blue [[Clothing/Legends|pants]], and brown boots.<ref name="TOR" />
